mentions.name: Simple.Photo
mentions.description: This tool makes it easy to create and share beautiful photo galleries that tell a story: folders of photos become a web gallery that works well on all devices. It offers a free, open-source CLI interface for self-hosting galleries, plus a managed SaaS version with a visual builder and hosted serving via CDN.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on a way to make it super easy to create and share beautiful photo galleries that tell a story. Take your folders with photos and create a web gallery that works great on all devices.

The project has a CLI interface that is free and open-source, but you have to self-host the gallery. We are also building a SaaS app which is basically a managed version of the open-source tool with a visual builder and we take care of the hosting and CDN.

mentions.name: Simple Photo Gallery
mentions.description: Open-source tool that generates photo galleries from a folder of photos, outputting static sites that are easy to self-host. Galleries work across devices, support rich photo descriptions, and are shareable via a simple link. V1 earned 200+ GitHub stars, V2 was recently released, and a SaaS offering for users who don't want to use the CLI or self-host is planned.
mentions.problem: There was no good tool for sharing travel and family photos with friends and family in a beautiful web gallery that works on all devices and supports rich descriptions.
mentions.audience: People sharing personal photos (e.g., travel and family photos) with friends and family via a simple link
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a open-source tool to create photo galleries from a folder of photos: https://simple.photo. It creates galleries as static sites that are easy to self-host.
